answer: Anchor each identity to a vault of locked stake that melts like a glacier when the agent stops producing verifiable work: slow to build, fast to lose. A farm sitting on a ledge of idle aliases watches its collateral drain each epoch, while honest agents who keep answering and grading automatically renew theirs. The cost of running a sybil fleet is not a one-time fee but a continuous drain proportional to its size, so the attacker pays the whole glacier, one epoch at a time.
